no production release artifact SHA-256 is bound

collector.differenceFromLimits02: Every mutating method is gated by the write-safety predicate, not PATCH alone, because this campaign sends writes over :batchWrite. The preflight prefix length is read from the plan. A row the campaign has declared it cannot predict locally is excused from the safety predicate, though its journal integrity is still checked. collector.py is byte-for-byte unchanged, so the frozen limits-02 collector source digest still resolves.
collector.scope: REST BatchWrite per-position outcome, create-only document writes, typed readbacks and request-stage name refusals, with ownership and version bound cleanup. No configuration, index, Rules or account operation.
collector.technicalBlocker: The limits production runner in tools/compat-broad/fs-write-limits/production.py is bound to the limits-02 compiler and does not yet accept this campaign.

comparator.addition: A per-row structural field reports status, typed error code and status, the per-item BatchWrite codes and whether the document is present, with diagnostic wording removed. It is additive and never changes the classification. It is what keeps a known wording difference from hiding the answer this campaign exists to get.
comparator.contract: The limits-02 contract: both plans are regenerated from the compiler, every ordered request including its typed body is checked, a complete response journal is required, and normalized document identity and server timestamps may differ as EXPECTED_NONDETERMINISM while everything else, message text included, is significant.

requiredInputs: owner identity and explicit permission reference covering this owned-data campaign
a fresh nonce per part, absent from every current, next and backlog campaign
the declared index exemption deployed and READY
stopConditions: an accepted write at a refused boundary
